title: Example guideline with bibliography (gui_Bob7x9KmPq2nL)
rule_text:
This is an example guideline demonstrating the bibliography feature.

As documented in [cite:gui_Bob7x9KmPq2nL:RUST-REF-UNION], union types in Rust have specific safety requirements.
The CERT C Coding Standard [cite:gui_Bob7x9KmPq2nL:CERT-C-INT34] provides guidance on avoiding undefined behavior
in shift operations, which applies to Rust as well.
